And I knew that my letter would not benefit them, and that Allah would carry out His command upon them." ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb said: "Let me strike his neck." He said: the Prophet ﷺ was silent, then said: "What do you know? Perhaps Allah has looked upon the people of Badr and said: Do what you will, for I have forgiven you."
Al-Farrāʾ said: Ḥibbān told me this with his chain of transmission.
And His saying: ﴿تُلْقُونَ إِلَيْهِمْ بِٱلْمَوَدَّةِ﴾: it is part of the ṣila (qualifying clause) of «الأولياء», as in your saying: «لا تتخذنّه رجلا تلقى إليه كلّ ما عندك» (do not take him as a man to whom you divulge everything you have).
And His saying: ﴿يُخْرِجُونَ ٱلرَّسُولَ وَإِيَّاكُمْ أَن تُؤْمِنُواْ﴾: (i.e.) «إن آمنتم» (if you believe) and «لإن آمنتم» (because you believe). Then He, Mighty and Majestic, said: ﴿إِن كُنتُمْ خَرَجْتُمْ جِهَاداً فِي سَبِيلِي﴾, then do not take them as allies.
«[Translator's note: «لإن» is as printed, presumably for «لأن» (because).]»

harrat-mujtaba:1-1.t: «أولياء» is a second object; the clause «تلقون» is explicative of their befriending them; the clause «وقد كفروا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in «تُلْقون»; the clause «يخرجون» is explicative of their disbelief; «وإياكم» is a detached accusative pronoun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «الرسول»; the maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن تؤمنوا» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); the clause «إن كنتم خرجتم» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, what precedes indicating it, i.e.: then do not take My enemy and your enemy as allies. «جهادا» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, i.e.: you strive (تجاهدون); the clause «تُسِرُّون» is resumptive; the clause «وأنا أعلم» is a ḥāl from the fāʿil (agent) of «تسرُّون»; the conditional clause is resumptive; the preposition phrase «منكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl from the fāʿil of «يفعله».

harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: The preposition phrase «لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «أعداء»; «لو» is maṣdariyya (infinitival), and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause «تكفرون» is the ṣila of the relative particle (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī).

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: «لا» is redundant (zāʾida), to emphasise the negation; «يوم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يفصل»; the preposition phrase «بما» is attached to «بصير».

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: The preposition phrase «لكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); the preposition phrase «في إبراهيم» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «أسوة»; the adverb «معه» is attached to the ṣila (relative clause); «إذ» is an adverbial noun, a badal (substitute) of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) from «إبراهيم»; the preposition phrase «منكم» is attached to «برآء», and the preposition phrase «مما» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the first preposition phrase; the preposition phrase «من دون» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «ما»; the clause «كفرنا» is resumptive within the scope of the saying; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن تؤمنوا» is genitive by «حتى», attached to «بدا»; «وحده» is a ḥāl from the Divine Name, and it is definite but interpreted as indefinite; «قول» is a connected excepted [noun] from his words «في إبراهيم», on the assumption of an omitted muḍāf, its implied form being: in the sayings of Ibrāhīm, except his saying such-and-such. The clause «لأستغفرن» is the answer to an implied (muqaddar) oath, and the oath with its answer is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl) of Ibrāhīm's saying; the clause «وما أملك» is conjoined to the clause of the answer to the oath; «شيء» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and «مِنْ» is redundant (zāʾida); the preposition phrase «لك» is attached to «أملك»; the preposition phrase «من الله» is attached to a ḥāl from «شيء»; the clause «ربنا» is resumptive within the scope of the saying; and the clause «عليك توكلنا», the answer to the vocative, is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: The clause «ربَّنا» is resumptive within the scope of the saying; the preposition phrase «للذين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «فتنة»; the clause «إنك أنت العزيز» is the answer to the last vocative; «أنت» is tawkīd (emphasis) of the kāf in «إنك».

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: The preposition phrase «فيهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «أسوة»; the preposition phrase «لمن» is a badal (substitute) from «لكم»; the clause «ومن يَتَوَلَّ» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause of the answer to the oath, «لقد كان»; «هو» is the separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl).

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: «عسى» is incomplete (nāqiṣa), and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is the khabar (predicate); the adverb «بينكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied (muqaddar) second object. The preposition phrase «منهم» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the relative noun; the clause «والله قدير» is resumptive, and the clause «والله غفور» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «الله قدير».

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: The preposition phrase «في الدين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يقاتلوكم»; the maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن تبرُّوهم» is a badal (substitute) from «الذين» before it, a badal of inclusion (badal ishtimāl).

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن تولَّوهم» is a badal (substitute) of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) from «الذين» before it. The conditional clause is resumptive. «هم» is a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position.

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: «الذين» is ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition); the conditional clause, the answer to the vocative, is resumptive; «إذا» is adverbial and conditional, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the meaning of the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); «مهاجرات» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «المؤمنات»; the clause (الله أعلم) is parenthetical; the preposition phrase «بإيمانهن» is attached to «أعلم»; the clause «فإنْ علمتموهن» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the conditional clause before it; «مؤمنات» is a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «لا هنَّ حلّ» is resumptive; «لا» is negative and inoperative (muhmala), and what follows it is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); «ما» is a relative noun, second mafʿūl bihi; the clause «ولا جناح عليكم» is conjoined to the clause «لا ترجعوهُنَّ»; the maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن تنكحوهن» is accusative by removal of the preposition (في); «إذا» is adverbial and conditional, attached to the meaning of the implied (muqaddar) apodosis, what precedes indicating it; «أجورهنَّ» is a second object; the clause «ولا تمسكوا» is conjoined to the clause «لا ترجعوهن»; the clause «ذلكم حكم» is resumptive; the clause «يحكم» is a ḥāl from «حكم», the linking element being implied, i.e.: by it (به); and the clause «والله عليم» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: The clause «وإن فاتكم شيء» is resumptive; the preposition phrase «من أزواجكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «فاتكم». The preposition phrase «إلى الكفار» is attached to «فات», which has been made to include the meaning of fleeing and going; the clause «فعاقبتم» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «فاتكم»; the clause «فآتوا» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); «مثل» is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «آتُوا»; the preposition phrase «به» is attached to «مؤمنون».

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: The conditional clause is resumptive, the answer to the vocative; his words «يبايعنك»: an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn because it is attached to the nūn, and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «المؤمنات»; the maṣdar (verbal noun) made genitive by «على» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb «يبايعنك»; «شيئا» is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause «يفترينه» is a naʿt (adjective) of «بهتان»; and the clause «فبايعهن» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: The clause «لا تتولَّوا», the answer to the vocative, is resumptive; the clause «غضب» is a naʿt (adjective) of «قوما»; the clause «يئسوا» is a second naʿt of «قوما»; the kāf is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: a despair like the despair (يأسا مثل يأس); «ما» is maṣdariyya (infinitival), and the maṣdar (verbal noun) is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

mekki-muskil:1-1.t:
His saying, Exalted is He, تلقونَ إِلَيْهِم بالمودة: تلقون is in the position of the accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of أولياء.
His saying يخرجُون الرَّسُول: in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the latent pronoun in كفروا.
His saying أَن تؤمنوا: أن is in the position of the accusative, a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose).
His saying إِن كُنْتُم خَرجْتُمْ: إنْ is for condition, and the apodosis of the condition is in the preceding speech, because it did not govern [anything] in the wording.
His saying جهادا: accusative as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of a ḥāl; it is also said that it is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi; like it is وابتغاء مرضاتي.

mekki-muskil:3-3.t: His saying يَوْم الْقِيَامَة يفصل بَيْنكُم: يوم is an adverb whose governing word is تنفعكم, and you pause on القيامة. It is also said that يفصل is the governing word in the adverb; then you pause on بينكم and do not pause on القيامة.

mekki-muskil:4-4.t:
His saying إِنَّا برآء مِنْكُم: it is the plural of بريء, like كريم and كرماء. Abū ʿAmr and ʿĪsā ibn ʿUmar permitted بِراء with a kasra on the بآء, treating it like كريم and كرام. Al-Farrāʾ permitted بَراء with a fatḥa on the بآء, in the form of the singular indicating the plural, as in His saying, Exalted is He, إنني براء مما تعبدون. براء is originally a maṣdar (verbal noun), so it applies to the singular and the plural in a single form; its precise sense is "I am possessed of disavowal", i.e. possessed of dissociation from you.
His saying أَن تبروهم: أن is in the position of the genitive as a badal (substitute) of الذين, and it is a badal of inclusion (badal al-ishtimāl); like it is أن تولوهم. It is also said that the two are mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose).
His saying إِلَّا قَول إِبْرَاهِيم: قول is an exception not of the same kind as the first (disconnected exception).

mekki-muskil:10-10.t:
His saying مهاجرات: accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of المؤمنات.
His saying مؤمنات: the second object of علم, and هنّ is the first.
His saying أَن تنكحوهن: أن is in the position of the accusative by the omission of the preposition, its implied form being "in marrying them" (في أن تنكحوهن), i.e. there is no blame on you in marrying them when you have given them their dues. [Translator's note: the edition prints «تنكحوهم» in the implied form.]

muyesser-irab:1-1.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا﴾: يا is a vocative particle; ﴿أي﴾ is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma; ها is for drawing attention (tanbīh); الذين is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿أي﴾; and the clause آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿لا تتخذوا عدوي وعدوكم أولياء﴾: لا is prohibitive; تتخذوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by ﴿لا﴾, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); عدوي is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); عدوكم is conjoined to عدوي; and أولياء is the second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿تلقون إليهم بالمودة﴾: تلقون is a verb and its fāʿil, and the mafʿūl bihi is omitted; the meaning of the bāʾ in ﴿بالمودة﴾ is then causal, as though it were said: ﴿تلقون إليهم أسرار رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وأخباره بسبب المودة التي بينكم﴾ ("you convey to them the secrets of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and his news because of the affection between you"). إليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تلقون﴾. بالمودة is a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to ﴿تلقون﴾. It has also been said: the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant), and المودة is itself the mafʿūl bihi of ﴿تلقون﴾. As for the clause ﴿تلقون﴾, there are four views about it:
The first: that it is explicative (tafsīriyya) of their taking them as allies.
The second: that it is resumptive; on these two views it has no grammatical position.
The third: that it is in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of ﴿تتخذوا﴾, i.e. "do not take [them as allies], conveying affection".
The fourth: that it is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿أولياء﴾.
﴿وقد كفروا بما جاءكم من الحق﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); كفروا is a verb and its fāʿil; the clause is a ḥāl from لا تتخذوا, or from تلقون; بما is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿كفروا﴾; the clause ﴿جاءكم﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and من الحق is a ḥāl.
﴿يخرجون الرسول وإياكم أن تؤمنوا بالله ربكم﴾: the clause ﴿يخرجون...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl from the pronoun in ﴿كفروا﴾. الرسول is the mafʿūl bihi, accusative by the fatḥa. إياكم is conjoined to الرسول; the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن تؤمنوا﴾ is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. "because of your believing in Allah"; ﴿بالله﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تؤمنوا﴾; and ربكم is a badal (substitute).
﴿إن كنتم خرجتم جهادا في سبيلي وابتغاء مرضاتي﴾: إن is conditional; كنتم is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb in the position of a jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the tāʾ is its noun (ism); the clause خرجتم is the khabar (predicate) of كنتم; جهادًا is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi, or a ḥāl, i.e. "in the state of your being strivers"; and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by His words: لا تتخذوا.
﴿تسرون إليهم بالمودة﴾: the clause تسرون is either resumptive, with no grammatical position, or it follows ﴿تلقون إليهم﴾ as a badal of part from whole (badal baʿḍ min kull); تسرون is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw is the fāʿil; the mafʿūl bihi is omitted; and بالمودة is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تسرون﴾, or the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila) on the object.
﴿وأنا أعلم بما أخفيتم وما أعلنتم﴾: the wāw is circumstantial. أنا is the mubtadaʾ (subject). أعلم is the khabar. بما is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أعلم﴾. The clause أخفيتم is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position. Or ﴿أعلم﴾ is an imperfect verb; and ﴿ما أعلنتم﴾ is conjoined to ﴿بما أخفيتم﴾.
﴿ومن يفعله منكم فقد ضل سواء السبيل﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, or the wāw is resumptive and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; من is a jussive-governing conditional noun in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ; يفعله is the protasis, its fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو), and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; the fāʾ links the apodosis of the condition because it is joined with قد; ضل is a verb, its fāʿil is "he" (هو), and سواء السبيل is its object; it has also been said that ضل is intransitive, so سواء السبيل is accusative as an adverb of place (ẓarfiyya makāniyya).

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿إن يثقفوكم يكونوا لكم أعداء﴾: إن is conditional; يثقفوكم is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent) and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); يكونوا is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), jussive, the sign of its jussive also being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is its noun (ism) and أعداء is its khabar (predicate); and لكم is a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ويبسطوا إليكم أيديهم وألسنتهم بالسوء﴾: conjoined to يكونوا; إليكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يبسطوا﴾; أيديهم is the mafʿūl bihi; ألسنتهم is conjoined to أيديهم; and بالسوء is a ḥāl.
﴿وودوا لو تكفرون﴾: also conjoined, to the clause of the condition and its requital; لو is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya); تكفرون is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); and the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿لو﴾ and what falls in its scope is the object of ﴿ودوا﴾.

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿لن تنفعكم أرحامكم ولا أولادكم﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; لن is a particle of negation, accusative and futurity; تنفعكم is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by لن; the kāf is a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); أرحامكم is a postponed fāʿil (agent); and لا أولادكم is conjoined to أرحامكم.
﴿يوم القيامة يفصل بينكم﴾: يوم القيامة is an adverb (ẓarf) attached to (mutaʿalliq) what precedes it, i.e. "they will not benefit you on the Day of Resurrection", so one pauses on it; or it is attached to what follows it, i.e. "He will judge between you on the Day of Resurrection"; يفصل is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil is "he" (هو); and بينكم is an adverb attached to يفصل in either case.
﴿والله بما تعملون بصير﴾: الله is the mubtadaʾ (subject); بما is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿بصير﴾; the clause تعملون is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and بصير is the khabar (predicate) of the Word of Majesty الله.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿قد كانت لكم أسوة حسنة في إبراهيم والذين معه﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); كانت is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of كان; أسوة is its postponed noun (ism); حسنة is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أسوة﴾; في إبراهيم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted second adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿أسوة﴾, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from it, since it has been described, or attached to an omitted khabar of كانت; الذين is conjoined to إبراهيم; and معه is an adverb of place, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿إذ قالوا لقومهم﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of a genitive (majrūr) as a badal of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) from إبراهيم والذين معه, or it is an adverb attached to the khabar of كان; the clause ﴿قالوا﴾ is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and لقومهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿قالوا﴾.
﴿إنا برآء منكم ومما تعبدون من دون الله﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), ﴿نا﴾ is its noun, and برآء is its khabar; the clause is the object of their saying (maqūl al-qawl); منكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿برآء﴾; مما is conjoined to منكم; the clause تعبدون is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; and من دون الله is a ḥāl.
﴿كفرنا بكم﴾: the clause is resumptive within the scope of the saying, with no grammatical position. كفرنا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent). بكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿كفرنا﴾.
﴿وبدا بيننا وبينكم العداوة والبغضاء أبدا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction. بدا is a past verb. بيننا is an adverb attached to ﴿بدا﴾. بينكم is an adverb conjoined to بيننا; العداوة is the fāʿil; البغضاء is conjoined to العداوة; and أبدًا is an adverb, also attached to ﴿بدا﴾.
﴿حتى تؤمنوا بالله وحده﴾: حتى is a particle of limit and genitive; تؤمنوا is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after حتى; the interpreted maṣdar from أن and the verb is genitive by حتى, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿أبدًا﴾; بالله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تؤمنوا﴾; and وحده is a ḥāl.
﴿إلا قول إبراهيم لأبيه﴾: إلا is a particle of exception; قول إبراهيم is excepted from أسوة حسنة, because the saying is part of the example, so it is a connected exception (istithnāʾ muttaṣil); it has also been said that it is a disconnected exception (istithnāʾ munqaṭiʿ); and لأبيه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿قول﴾.
﴿لأستغفرن لك وما أملك لك من الله من شيء﴾: the lām occurs in the answer to a supplied oath; أستغفرن is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "I" (أنا); the clause is the object of the saying; لك is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أستعفرن﴾ [Translator's note: so spelled in the source; the verb is أستغفرن]; the wāw is circumstantial, or conjunctive, because the clause is part of the completion of Ibrāhīm's saying, so it is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl from the fāʿil of أستغفرن, i.e. "I will ask forgiveness for you [while not owning…]", so it is built on what precedes it and ordered upon it by way of being a ḥāl; ما is negative; أملك is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "I" (أنا); لك is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أملك﴾; من الله is a ḥāl, because it was originally an adjective (ṣifa) of شيء; من is a connective (ṣila, i.e. redundant) preposition; and شيء is genitive in form and accusative in position, as the object of أملك.
﴿ربنا عليك توكلنا وإليك أنبنا وإليك المصير﴾: ربنا is the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf; عليك is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿توكلنا﴾; إليك is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أنبنا﴾; the wāw is a conjunction; إليك is a fronted khabar; and المصير is a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject).

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿ربنا لا تجعلنا فتنة للذين كفروا﴾: ربنا is the one addressed (munādā), likewise a muḍāf; لا is of request (ṭalabiyya), for supplication; تجعلنا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا; نا is the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and فتنة is the second mafʿūl bihi; it is a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the sense of the agent, i.e. "do not make us a cause of trial for them, by their gaining victory over us", or in the sense of the patient, i.e. "do not make us tried by them, by Your giving them power over us"; للذين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿فتنة﴾ on both interpretations; and the clause كفروا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿واغفر لنا ربنا إنك أنت العزيز الحكيم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; اغفر is a verb of supplication (fiʿl duʿāʾ); لنا is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿اغفر﴾; ربنا is the one addressed, a muḍāf, repeated for emphasis; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), and the kāf is its noun (ism); أنت is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl), or a mubtadaʾ (subject); العزيز is the khabar (predicate) of إن, or the khabar of أنت, and that clause is the khabar of إن; and الحكيم is a second khabar in either case.

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
﴿لقد كان لكم فيهم أسوة حسنة لمن كان يرجو الله واليوم الآخر﴾: the clause follows the clause ﴿قد كانت لكم أسوة﴾ as an emphasis of it, brought for intensity in urging the ruling; the lām occurs in the answer to a supplied oath; قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); كان is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; لكم is its fronted khabar (predicate); فيهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿أسوة﴾; أسوة is the postponed noun (ism) of كان; حسنة is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أسوة﴾; لمن is a badal of part from whole (badal baʿḍ min kull) from ﴿لكم﴾, with repetition of the preposition, and it has been said: a badal of inclusion (badal ishtimāl); the clause ﴿كان﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. The noun of كان is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); the clause يرجو الله is the khabar of كان; and اليوم الآخر is conjoined to the Word of Majesty (lafẓ al-jalāla).
﴿ومن يتول فإن الله هو الغني الحميد﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; من is a jussive-governing conditional noun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as mubtadaʾ (subject); يتول is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; the fāʾ links the apodosis; the apodosis is omitted, its implied form being "then the evil consequence of his turning away is upon himself"; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the Word of Majesty is its noun; الغني is the khabar of إن, nominative by the ḍamma; الحميد is a second khabar of إن, nominative by the ḍamma; and the clause has no grammatical position, because it gives the reason for the supplied apodosis.

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿عسى الله أن يجعل بينكم وبين الذين عاديتم منهم مودة﴾: عسى is a verb, one of the verbs of hope (afʿāl al-rajāʾ); the Word of Majesty (lafẓ al-jalāla) is its noun (ism); أن يجعل is in the place of the khabar (predicate); بينكم is an adverb (ẓarf) in the place of the second object of يجعل; بين الذين عاديتم is conjoined to the adverb; مودة is the first object of يجعل; and منهم is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from الذين عاديتم.
﴿والله قدير والله غفور رحيم﴾: a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar, and their like conjoined to them.

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿لا ينهاكم الله عن الذين لم يقاتلوكم في الدين﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; لا is negative; ينهاكم الله is an imperfect verb, a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and a postponed fāʿil (agent); عن الذين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ينهاكم﴾; the clause ﴿لم يقاتلوكم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. في الدين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يقاتلوكم﴾, i.e. "on its account".
﴿ولم يخرجوكم من دياركم أن تبروهم وتقسطوا إليهم إن الله يحب المقسطين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لم يخرجوكم is conjoined to ﴿لم يقاتلوكم﴾; من دياركم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يخرجوكم﴾; أن تبروهم is in the place of a genitive (majrūr) as a badal of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) from الذين; تقسطوا إليهم is conjoined to تبروهم; إن is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh), the Word of Majesty is its noun (ism), and the clause يحب المقسطين is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿إنما ينهاكم الله عن الذين قاتلوكم في الدين﴾: إنما is a restraining particle and the restrained one (kāffa wa-makfūfa); ينهاكم الله is an imperfect verb, a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and a postponed fāʿil (agent); عن الذين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ينهاكم﴾; the clause قاتلوكم is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position. في الدين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿قاتلوكم﴾.
﴿وأخرجوكم من دياركم وظاهروا على إخراجكم أن تولوهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أخرجوكم is conjoined to قاتلوكم; من دياركم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أخرجوكم﴾; ظاهروا is also conjoined; على إخراجكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ظاهروا﴾, i.e. "they helped in expelling you"; and أن together with what falls in its scope is a badal of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) from الذين.
﴿ومن يتولهم فأولئك هم الظالمون﴾: the wāw is resumptive; من is a jussive-governing conditional noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject); يتولهم is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the fāʾ is linking (rābiṭa); the clause أولئك هم الظالمون is in the position of a jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the protasis together with its apodosis is the khabar (predicate) of من; and the clause ﴿ومن يتولهم...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا﴾: يا is a vocative particle; أي is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of an accusative (manṣūb); ها is for drawing attention (tanbīh); الذين is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿أي﴾; and the clause آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿إذا جاءكم المؤمنات مهاجرات فامتحنوهن﴾: إذا is an adverb (ẓarf) of future time, putting its condition in the genitive and made accusative by its apodosis; the clause جاءكم is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) through the adverb's being annexed to it; المؤمنات is a postponed fāʿil (agent); مهاجرات is a ḥāl (circumstantial); the fāʾ is linking (rābiṭa); the clause امتحنوهن has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; امتحنوهن is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, the wāw is the fāʿil, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿الله أعلم بإيمانهن﴾: الله is the mubtadaʾ (subject); أعلم is the khabar (predicate); بإيمانهن is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أعلم﴾, because it is an elative (afʿal tafḍīl); the fāʾ is a conjunction; إن is conditional; علمتموهن is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and it is a verb, its fāʿil, and its first mafʿūl bihi; and مؤمنات is the second mafʿūl bihi. [Translator's note: the source places the analysis of فإن علمتموهن مؤمنات under this phrase, before the next heading.]
﴿فإن علمتموهن مؤمنات فلا ترجعوهن إلى الكفار﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, because it is a clause of request (ṭalabiyya); لا is prohibitive; ترجعوهن is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; and إلى الكفار is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ترجعوهن﴾.
﴿لا هن حل لهم ولا هم يحلون لهن﴾: the clause has no grammatical position, because it is causal (taʿlīliyya), giving the reason for His words ﴿فلا ترجعوهن﴾; لا is negative; هن is a mubtadaʾ and حل is a khabar; لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿حل﴾; and لا هم يحلون لهن is conjoined to the preceding clause, parallel to it.
﴿وآتوهم ما أنفقوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; آتوهم is a past verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi [Translator's note: so in the source; آتوهم is in fact an imperative verb]; the pronoun refers to the disbelievers, i.e. "give their disbelieving husbands what they spent on them"; ما is the second mafʿūl bihi; and the clause أنفقوا is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿ولا جناح عليكم أن تنكحوهن إذا آتيتموهن أجورهن﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is the lā of generic negation; جناح is its noun (ism), indeclinable on the fatḥa; عليكم is the khabar of لا; أن is a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle; تنكحوهن is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by أن; the interpreted maṣdar is accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), i.e. "in your marrying them", and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿جناح﴾; إذا is an adverb that includes the sense of condition; the clause آتيتموهن is in the position of a genitive through the adverb's being annexed to it; and أجورهن is the second object of ﴿آتيتموهن﴾.
﴿ولا تمسكوا بعصم الكوافر﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive; تمسكوا is an imperfect verb, jussive by ﴿لا﴾, and the wāw is the fāʿil; and بعصم الكوافر is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تمسكوا﴾.
﴿واسألوا ما أنفقتم وليسألوا ما أنفقوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; اسألوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; ما is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause أنفقتم is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position. وليسألوا: the wāw is a conjunction, the lām is the lām of command, and يسألوا is an imperfect verb, jussive by the lām of command; ما is the mafʿūl bihi; and the clause أنفقوا is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿ذلكم حكم الله يحكم بينكم﴾: ذلكم is the mubtadaʾ, the reference being to the ruling given in the verses; حكم الله is the khabar; the clause ﴿يحكم بينكم﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or a ḥāl from حكم الله; and بينكم is an adverb attached to ﴿يحكم﴾.
﴿والله عليم حكيم﴾: الله is the mubtadaʾ; عليم is the first khabar, and حكيم the second khabar.

muyesser-irab:11-11.t:
﴿وإن فاتكم شيء من أزواجكم إلى الكفار﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن is a jussive-governing conditional particle; فات is a past verb in the position of a jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the pronoun of address is in the position of an accusative (manṣūb) as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); شيء is the fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma; من أزواجكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) فاتكم; إلى الكفار is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿فات﴾, which has come to include the sense of fleeing and going; and the protasis clause has no grammatical position.
﴿فعاقبتم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; عاقبتم is a past verb and its fāʿil; and the clause has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the protasis clause.
﴿فآتوا الذين ذهبت أزواجهم﴾: the fāʾ is in the apodosis of the condition; آتوا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil; الذين is a relative noun in the position of an accusative as the first mafʿūl bihi; ذهبت is a past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine; أزواجهم is the fāʿil, nominative by the ḍamma, and the pronoun is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the clause ﴿ذهبت أزواجهم﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿مثل﴾: the mafʿūl bihi, accusative by the fatḥa.
﴿ما﴾: a relative noun in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿أنفقوا﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of the relative noun; the clause ﴿فآتوا﴾ is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), joined with the fāʾ; and the whole conditional sentence has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the preceding conditional sentence.
﴿واتقوا الله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; اتقوا is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is in the position of a nominative as fāʿil; and the Word of Majesty (lafẓ al-jalāla) is the mafʿūl bihi, accusative by the fatḥa.
﴿الذي﴾: a relative noun in the position of an accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of the name of Allah; and the clause is in the position of a jussive, being conjoined to the apodosis.
﴿أنتم به مؤمنون﴾: أنتم is a pronoun in the position of a nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); به is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿مؤمنون﴾; مؤمنون is the khabar (predicate), nominative by the wāw; and the nominal clause has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of the relative noun.

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿يا أيها النبي﴾: يا is a vocative particle; أي is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of an accusative (manṣūb); ها is for drawing attention (tanbīh); and النبي is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿أي﴾.
﴿إذا جاءك المؤمنات﴾: إذا is a future adverb (ẓarf) that includes the sense of condition; the clause جاءك is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) through the adverb's being annexed to it; the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and المؤمنات is the fāʿil (agent).
﴿يبايعنك﴾: يبايعنك is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the sukūn because it is joined to the nūn of the feminine plural (nūn al-niswa); the nūn is the fāʿil and the kāf is the mafʿūl bihi; and the clause is circumstantial (a ḥāl), i.e. "in the state of their seeking the pledge".
﴿على أن لا يشركن بالله شيئا﴾: على is a preposition; ﴿أن﴾ is a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle; ﴿لا﴾ is negative; ﴿يشركن﴾ is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the sukūn because it is joined to the nūn of the feminine plural, in the position of an accusative. أن together with what falls in its scope is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of a genitive by ﴿على﴾, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يبايعنك﴾. In ﴿بالله﴾ the bāʾ is a preposition and the Word of Majesty (lafẓ al-jalāla) is a genitive noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿يشركن﴾. ﴿شيئًا﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi, or a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). The clause ﴿لا يشركن﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the maṣdar-forming ﴿أن﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿ولا يسرقن ولا يزنين ولا يقتلن أولادهن﴾: ﴿لا﴾ is negative; ﴿يسرقن﴾ is an imperfect verb in the position of an accusative by conjunction with يشركن; the nūn of the feminine plural is the fāʿil, in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ); and the clause ﴿يسرقن﴾ has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the ṣila of the maṣdar-forming ﴿أن﴾. ﴿ولا يزنين ولا يقتلن﴾: the two clauses have no grammatical position, being conjoined to the ṣila clause. ﴿أولادهن﴾ is the mafʿūl bihi, accusative by the fatḥa, and the pronoun is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿ولا يأتين ببهتان يفترينه﴾: ﴿لا﴾ is negative; ﴿يأتين﴾ is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of a nominative [Translator's note: so in the source; on the source's own analysis of the parallel verbs يشركن and يسرقن above, its position would be accusative], and the nūn is in the position of a nominative as fāʿil; ﴿ببهتان﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يأتين﴾; the clause has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the ṣila clause; ﴿يفترينه﴾ is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of a nominative; the nūn of the feminine plural is the fāʿil; and the hāʾ is a pronoun in the position of an accusative as mafʿūl bihi.
﴿بين أيديهن وأرجلهن﴾: ﴿بين﴾ is an adverb (ẓarf), accusative by the fatḥa, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the mafʿūl bihi; ﴿أيديهن﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi, genitive by the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ, and the pronoun is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿وأرجلهن﴾ is conjoined to أيديهن, genitive by the kasra; and the clause ﴿يفترينه﴾ is in the position of a genitive as a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿بهتان﴾.
﴿ولا يعصينك﴾: conjoined to لا يشركن; ﴿لا﴾ is negative; ﴿يعصينك﴾ is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of a nominative; the nūn is in the position of a nominative as fāʿil; and the kāf is in the position of an accusative as mafʿūl bihi.
﴿في معروف﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يعصينك﴾; and the clause ﴿لا يعصينك﴾ has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the ṣila clause.
﴿فبايعهن﴾: the fāʾ is in the apodosis of the condition إذا; the imperative verb is indeclinable on the sukūn; the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "you" (أنت); the feminine-plural pronoun is in the position of an accusative as mafʿūl bihi; the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the whole conditional sentence has no grammatical position, because it is the answer to the vocative; and the vocative clause has no grammatical position, because it is resumptive.
﴿واستغفر لهن الله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; استغفر is an imperative verb; ﴿لهن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿استغفر﴾; and the Word of Majesty is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿إن الله غفور رحيم﴾: the clause gives the reason for the command to seek forgiveness.

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا﴾: يا is a vocative particle; أي is the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of an accusative (manṣūb); ها is for drawing attention (tanbīh); الذين is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿أي﴾; and the clause آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.
﴿لا تتولوا قوما غضب الله عليهم﴾: لا is prohibitive; تتولوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; قومًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause غضب الله عليهم is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿قومًا﴾.
﴿قد يئسوا من الآخرة كما يئس الكفار من أصحاب القبور﴾: the clause is a second naʿt of ﴿قومًا﴾, or a ḥāl (circumstantial) after it has been described; قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); يئسوا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); من الآخرة is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يئسوا﴾; in ﴿كما﴾ the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of an accusative as an adjective (ṣifa) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), and ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdar-forming; يئس الكفار is a verb and its fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿ما﴾ and the verb is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿يئس الكفار...﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of the maṣdar-forming ﴿ما﴾; ﴿من أصحاب﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl from الكفار, i.e. "being among the people of the graves", or attached to يئس, i.e. "they despaired of the resurrection of the people of the graves". ﴿القبور﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi.

nahhas-irab:1-1.t:
أيّ is a singular vocative, and الَّذِينَ, part of its description (naʿt), is in the position of a nominative; some grammarians permit the accusative according to the position. Some of them said: «أيّ» is an incomplete noun and what follows it is its ṣila (relative clause); this is an error according to the view of al-Khalīl and Sībawayh. The view according to them is that it is a complete noun, except that it must have a naʿt, like «من» and «ما» when they are indefinite. Sībawayh recited: [al-Kāmil] 482-
فكفى بنا فضلا على من غيرنا ... حبّ النّبيّ محمّد إيّانا
(It suffices us as a distinction over anyone other than us that the Prophet Muḥammad loves us)
 His saying غيرنا is a naʿt of من which does not leave it. لا تَتَّخِذُوا عَدُوِّي وَعَدُوَّكُمْ in the meaning of "My enemies"; عدوّ applies to the plural, the singular and the feminine in one form, because it does not run on the pattern of the verb; and if you wish, you may make it plural and feminine. أَوْلِياءَ is the second object. أولياء is not fully declined (a diptote) because at its end there is an additional alif, and everything at whose end there is an additional alif is not fully declined, whether definite or indefinite, e.g. عرفاء, شهداء, أصدقاء, أصفياء and مرضى. You know that the alif is additional by looking at its [pattern in] fiʿl: if you find an alif after the lām of its fiʿl, it is additional. Do you not see that عرفاء is fuʿalāʾ and أصفياء is afʿilāʾ, so that after the lām there is an alif; likewise مرضى is faʿlā. Plurals other than this are fully declined, e.g. غلمان, رجال, أعدال, فلوس and شباب — except that أشياء alone is not fully declined, whether definite or indefinite, because of the heaviness of the feminine marker: they found it heavy to add tanwīn together with the additional feminine letter, because by it afʿilāʾ is intended, as in أصدقاء — as though they intended أشيئاء, which is the original, and it became heavy because of the combination of the yāʾ and the two hamzas, so they dropped one of the two hamzas. [Translator's note: the print has أشياء where أشيئاء is evidently meant.] What resembles it is fully declined, definite or indefinite, e.g. أسماء, أحياء and أفياء, which are fully declined because they are afʿāl; of this kind are أعدال and أجمال. Likewise عدوّ and أعداء is fully declined, and likewise His saying, the Exalted: إِنْ يَثْقَفُوكُمْ يَكُونُوا لَكُمْ أَعْداءً is fully declined because it is afʿāl and has no additional alif. تُلْقُونَ إِلَيْهِمْ بِالْمَوَدَّةِ: the position of al-Farrāʾ is that the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida) and that the meaning is "you offer them affection". Abū Jaʿfar said: «تلقون» is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), and it may be in the position of a naʿt of أولياء. Al-Farrāʾ said: just as you say: "Do not take a man to whom you offer everything you have." وَقَدْ كَفَرُوا بِما جاءَكُمْ مِنَ الْحَقِّ يُخْرِجُونَ الرَّسُولَ وَإِيَّاكُمْ: conjoined to الرسول, i.e. "and they drive you out". أَنْ تُؤْمِنُوا بِاللَّهِ رَبِّكُمْ is in the position of an accusative, i.e. "because you believe", and its real sense is "out of dislike that you believe in Allah your Lord". إِنْ كُنْتُمْ خَرَجْتُمْ جِهاداً فِي سَبِيلِي: جهادا is accusative because it is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), or as a maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. if you have gone out striving in My way which I have laid down and My religion which I have commanded. وابْتِغاءَ مَرْضاتِي is conjoined. تُسِرُّونَ إِلَيْهِمْ بِالْمَوَدَّةِ is like تلقون. وَأَنَا أَعْلَمُ: the reading of the people of Medina keeps the alif [of أنا] in continuous speech, and the reading of others is وأن أعلم, dropping the alif in continuous speech; this is what is well known in the speech of the Arabs, because the alif is for showing the vowel, so it is not kept in continuous speech, since the vowel is already established. أَعْلَمُ has the meaning of عالم, just as one says الله أكبر الله أكبر in the meaning of كبير; and the meaning may be "and I know better about you, about what some of you conceal from others and what you disclose". وَمَنْ يَفْعَلْهُ مِنْكُمْ: and whoever offers them affection and takes them as allies, فَقَدْ ضَلَّ سَواءَ السَّبِيلِ i.e. [strayed] from the straight course of the road to Paradise and its highway.

nahhas-irab:2-2.t: إِنْ يَثْقَفُوكُمْ يَكُونُوا لَكُمْ أَعْداءً: a condition and its requital, and for that reason the nūn is dropped; and likewise وَيَبْسُطُوا إِلَيْكُمْ أَيْدِيَهُمْ وَأَلْسِنَتَهُمْ بِالسُّوءِ. The sentence is complete.

nahhas-irab:3-3.t: لَنْ تَنْفَعَكُمْ أَرْحامُكُمْ وَلا أَوْلادُكُمْ, because their children and relatives were in Mecca, and for that reason some of them sought to gain favour with the people of Mecca; and Allah, Majestic and Mighty, informed them that they would not benefit them on the Day of Resurrection. On this [reading] what governs the adverb is لن تنفعكم, and يفصل بينكم is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). It may be that what governs the adverb is يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَكُمْ. This [Translator's note: i.e. yufṣalu, passive, as the following remark implies; the print shows yafṣilu] is the reading of the people of the two Sanctuaries and the people of Basra, it being known that the meaning is "Allah, Majestic and Mighty, will judge between you". ʿAbd Allāh ibn ʿĀmir read يفصّل [yufaṣṣalu], expressing multiplicity; ʿĀṣim read يفصل [yafṣilu]; and Yaḥyā ibn Waththāb, al-Aʿmash, Ḥamza and al-Kisāʾī read يفصّل بينكم [yufaṣṣilu], as the intensive of يفصل. وَاللَّهُ بِما تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ: a mubtadaʾ and its khabar.

nahhas-irab:4-4.t:
قَدْ كانَتْ لَكُمْ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ: al-Farrāʾ related as its plural أسى [usan], with ḍamma in the plural even if the singular has kasra, in order to distinguish between those with wāw and those with yāʾ. According to the Basrans the ḍamma is permissible by likening fiʿla to fuʿla, and the kasra is permissible according to the original. فِي إِبْراهِيمَ وَالَّذِينَ مَعَهُ: ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Zayd said: الَّذِينَ مَعَهُ are the prophets, peace be upon them. قالُوا لِقَوْمِهِمْ i.e. when they said to their people: إِنَّا بُرَآؤُا مِنْكُمْ — this is the well-known reading which the imams read, as you say كريم and كرماء. Abū ʿAmr and ʿĪsā permitted إنا براء منكم [biraʾun], which is a well-known, eloquent dialect, as you say كريم and كرام. Al-Farrāʾ permitted إنا برآء منكم [baraʾun]. Abū Jaʿfar said: this is sound in Arabic: برآء is used for the singular and the plural in one form, as in إنني برآء منكم; its real sense in the plural is "we are possessors of disavowal (barāʾ)", just as you say قوم رضى. So these are three well-known dialects. The Kufans related a fourth dialect, and it is related that Abū Jaʿfar read with it: أنا برآء منكم [Translator's note: i.e. burāʾu without the medial hamza, as the following comparison shows], on the pattern of براع [burāʿ]; this is not permissible according to the Basrans because it is dropping something without a cause. Abū Jaʿfar [al-Naḥḥās] said: I do not reckon this to be from Abū Jaʿfar [the reader] except as a mistake, because it is narrated from ʿĪsā that he read with lightening of the hamza: أنّا برأ, and I reckon that Abū Jaʿfar read so. وَمِمَّا تَعْبُدُونَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ is conjoined with repetition of the genitive-governing particle, as you say أخذته منك ومن زيد, and أخذته منك وزيد is not permissible. Do you not see how the written text (al-sawād) has ومما in it? Had it been according to the reading of whoever read والأرحام [al-Nisāʾ: 1] [Translator's note: i.e. in the genitive, conjoined to a pronoun without repeating the preposition], it would have been وما تعبدون من دون الله, without من. كَفَرْنا بِكُمْ i.e. we have rejected your disbelief. وَبَدا بَيْنَنا وَبَيْنَكُمُ الْعَداوَةُ وَالْبَغْضاءُ أَبَداً: [بدا is masculine] because the femininity is not real; i.e. we will not love you. حَتَّى تُؤْمِنُوا بِاللَّهِ وَحْدَهُ إِلَّا قَوْلَ إِبْراهِيمَ لِأَبِيهِ لَأَسْتَغْفِرَنَّ لَكَ: an exception not of [the kind of] the first (istithnāʾ munqaṭiʿ), i.e. do not seek forgiveness for the polytheists, saying "one follows the example of Abraham ﷺ", since he did that only because of a promise he had made him. It is said: he [the father] promised him that he would make his Islam manifest, and he did not seek forgiveness for him except after he had become Muslim.
وَما أَمْلِكُ لَكَ مِنَ اللَّهِ مِنْ شَيْءٍ i.e. I am not able to ward off His punishment and penalty from you. رَبَّنا عَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْنا: there are two views on its meaning. One of them is that this is the saying of Abraham and the prophets with him; the other is that the meaning is:
"say: Our Lord, upon You we rely", i.e. we have entrusted all our affairs to You. And it is said: the meaning of reliance (tawakkul) on Allah, Majestic and Mighty, is that He is worshipped alone and not disobeyed [Translator's note: printed ولا يعبى; ولا يُعصى is presumably intended], and that one trusts His promise to whoever obeys Him. وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْنا i.e. we have turned back from what You dislike to what You love. وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ i.e. our destination and the destination of creation on the Day of Resurrection.

nahhas-irab:5-5.t: رَبَّنا لا تَجْعَلْنا فِتْنَةً لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا: Ibn Abī Ṭalḥa narrated from Ibn ʿAbbās, who said: it means: do not give them power over us so that they put us to trial. وَاغْفِرْ لَنا: assimilating the rāʾ into the lām is not permissible, lest the trill (takrīr) of the rāʾ be lost. إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْعَزِيزُ in Your retribution on whomever You take retribution on, الْحَكِيمُ in the management of Your servants.

nahhas-irab:6-6.t: لَقَدْ كانَ لَكُمْ فِيهِمْ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ: He did not say كانت because the femininity is not real; its meaning is "following an example" (al-taʾassī). لِمَنْ كانَ يَرْجُوا اللَّهَ i.e. His reward, وَالْيَوْمَ الْآخِرَ i.e. its deliverance. وَمَنْ يَتَوَلَّ is jussive by the condition, and for that reason the yāʾ [Translator's note: i.e. the final weak letter] has been dropped from it; and the apodosis is فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْغَنِيُّ الْحَمِيدُ.

nahhas-irab:7-7.t: أَنْ يَجْعَلَ: some Arabs omit «أن» after «عسى». Ibn Zayd said: then Mecca was conquered, and the affection came about through their acceptance of Islam. وَاللَّهُ قَدِيرٌ i.e. able to put affection between you and them. وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ i.e. [forgiving] to whoever took them as allies and offered them affection, when he repents; merciful to him, for whom He punishes him after repentance [Translator's note: so in the source, لمن يعذبه; presumably لا يعذبه, "not punishing him after repentance", is intended]. Mercy from Allah, Majestic and Mighty, is accepting the deed and rewarding it.

nahhas-irab:8-8.t: Abū Jaʿfar said: we have mentioned it. The view of whoever said that it is abrogated has no sense, because al-birr (kindness) in the language is only gentle speech and consolation, and it is not forbidden for anyone to do this toward a disbeliever. Likewise al-iqsāṭ is only justice and repaying good with good. Do you not see that after it comes إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُقْسِطِينَ. And أن [Translator's note: i.e. أَنْ تَبَرُّوهُمْ] is in the position of a genitive as a badal (substitute) for الَّذِينَ; and it may be in the position of an accusative, i.e. He does not forbid you out of dislike of this.

nahhas-irab:9-9.t: أَنْ تَوَلَّوْهُمْ: the original is تتولّوهم. وَمَنْ يَتَوَلَّهُمْ i.e. helps them and loves them, فَأُولئِكَ هُمُ الظَّالِمُونَ i.e. those who placed affection in other than its place. Ẓulm in the language is putting a thing in other than its place.

nahhas-irab:10-10.t:
يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِذا جاءَكُمُ الْمُؤْمِناتُ: on the basis of treating the plural as masculine. مُهاجِراتٍ is accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). فَامْتَحِنُوهُنَّ i.e. test them, whether they came out for a reason other than desire for Islam. اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِإِيمانِهِنَّ i.e. than you; then it was omitted because the hearer knows it. فَإِنْ عَلِمْتُمُوهُنَّ مُؤْمِناتٍ: second object. فَلا تَرْجِعُوهُنَّ إِلَى الْكُفَّارِ: that was because of a truce there was between them. لا هُنَّ حِلٌّ لَهُمْ وَلا هُمْ يَحِلُّونَ لَهُنَّ, because a Muslim woman is not lawful to a disbeliever in any circumstance. وَلا جُناحَ عَلَيْكُمْ أَنْ تَنْكِحُوهُنَّ إِذا آتَيْتُمُوهُنَّ أُجُورَهُنَّ i.e. he may marry her when she has become Muslim while her husband is a disbeliever, because the marriage bond between them has been cut — and that is after the expiry of the waiting period (ʿidda); and likewise if he apostatizes. وأتوهم ما أنفقوا [Translator's note: so in the source, for وَآتُوهُمْ ما أَنْفَقُوا]: that is the dower. وَلا تُمْسِكُوا بِعِصَمِ الْكَوافِرِ: Abū ʿAmr read ولا تمسكوا [Translator's note: i.e. tumassikū, with doubling], which may have the same meaning or express multiplicity; and from al-Ḥasan: ولا تمسّكوا [tamassakū], the original being تتمسّكوا, with the tāʾ dropped because of the meeting of the two tāʾs. عصم is the plural of عصمة; one says أخذت بعصمتها, i.e. by her hand, and it is a metonymy for intercourse. الْكَوافِرِ is the plural of كافرة, specific to the feminine.
وَسْئَلُوا ما أَنْفَقْتُمْ وَلْيَسْئَلُوا ما أَنْفَقُوا: that is about the dower. ذلِكُمْ حُكْمُ اللَّهِ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَكُمْ وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ: al-Zuhrī said: the Muslims said, "We are content with the judgement of Allah, Majestic and Mighty," and the disbelievers refused to be content with the judgement of Allah and to acknowledge that it is from Him.

nahhas-irab:11-11.t:
There are two views on its meaning. Al-Zuhrī said: the disbelievers here are those between whom and the Prophet ﷺ there was a covenant of protection (dhimma); and Mujāhid and Qatāda said: they are the people of war who have no covenant. فَعاقَبْتُمْ: Ḥumayd al-Aʿraj and ʿIkrima read فعقّبتم; according to al-Farrāʾ the two have one meaning, like «ولا تصاعر» and وَلا تُصَعِّرْ [Luqmān: 18]. It is related that in the codex (ḥarf) of ʿAbd Allāh: وإن فاتكم أحد من أزواجكم; when it refers to people, both أحد and شيء are fitting, and when it refers to other than people, أحد is not fitting. From Mujāhid: فأعقبتم. All of it is taken from al-ʿāqiba and al-ʿuqbā, which is what follows a thing.
فَآتُوا الَّذِينَ ذَهَبَتْ أَزْواجُهُمْ مِثْلَ ما أَنْفَقُوا: the scholars differed about its ruling. Al-Zuhrī said: the one whose wife has gone over to the disbelievers who have a covenant is given the equivalent of her dower, and it is taken from whoever marries one of the women who came from them and given to him. Masrūq, Mujāhid and Qatāda said: rather, he is given from the spoils. Abū Jaʿfar said:
this interpretation is on the basis that his wife goes over to the people of war who have no covenant. وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ الَّذِي أَنْتُمْ بِهِ مُؤْمِنُونَ i.e. fear Him in what He has commanded you and forbidden you.

nahhas-irab:12-12.t: يا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ إِذا جاءَكَ الْمُؤْمِناتُ يُبايِعْنَكَ: [يبايعنك is] in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). عَلى أَنْ لا يُشْرِكْنَ بِاللَّهِ شَيْئاً i.e. on condition that they do not worship any other with Him nor take a god besides Him. يُشْرِكْنَ is in the position of an accusative by أن, and it may be in the position of a nominative in the sense of "on condition that they [shall not]" (على أنهنّ); and likewise وَلا يَسْرِقْنَ وَلا يَزْنِينَ وَلا يَقْتُلْنَ أَوْلادَهُنَّ وَلا يَأْتِينَ بِبُهْتانٍ يَفْتَرِينَهُ بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِنَّ وَأَرْجُلِهِنَّ وَلا يَعْصِينَكَ فِي مَعْرُوفٍ. All these verbs are indeclinable (mabnī), and for that reason their nominative, accusative and jussive are all one. Ibn Abī Ṭalḥa narrated from Ibn ʿAbbās: وَلا يَعْصِينَكَ فِي مَعْرُوفٍ — he says: they shall not wail [over the dead]. Ibn Zayd said: they shall not disobey you in anything good you command them. فَبايِعْهُنَّ وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُنَّ اللَّهَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ: assimilating the rāʾ into the lām is not permissible, but concealment (ikhfāʾ) is permissible, and this is what is authentically reported from Abū ʿAmr; whoever hears it imagines it to be assimilation.

nahhas-irab:13-13.t: يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لا تَتَوَلَّوْا قَوْماً غَضِبَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ: Ibn Zayd said: they are the Jews. قَدْ يَئِسُوا مِنَ الْآخِرَةِ كَما يَئِسَ الْكُفَّارُ مِنْ أَصْحابِ الْقُبُورِ: we have mentioned it. Among the best of what has been said about it — and it is the meaning of Ibn Zayd's view — is: they have despaired of the reward of the Hereafter [Translator's note: printed ثوب, for ثواب], because they disbelieved in the Prophet ﷺ and denied his description, which is written with them and which they had come across; just as the disbelievers who have died have also despaired of the reward of the Hereafter, because they disbelieved and denied, for the disbelief of these [Translator's note: so in the source, لكفر هؤلاء; the phrase is unclear].

safi-cedvel:1-3.t:
* I'rab:
(أيّها) the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative. (الذين) a badal (substitute) for أيّ, in the position of the accusative — or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition). (لا) prohibitive, jussive-governing. (أولياء) second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb). (إليهم) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (تلقون), and likewise (بالمودّة) [Note: Or attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the agent of تلقون, the bāʾ being for accompaniment (mulābasa), and the object of تلقون is omitted, i.e. "you convey to them the news of the Messenger".. And it has been said: the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida) on the object.], and (الباء) is causal. (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya). (قد) a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). (بما) attached to (كفروا). (من الحقّ) attached to a ḥāl from the agent of جاءكم. (إيّاكم) a detached pronoun in the position of the accusative, maʿṭūf (conjoined) to الرسول by the wāw. (أن) a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle. (باللَّه) attached to (تؤمنوا).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تؤمنوا..) is in the position of the genitive by an omitted preposition, namely the lām, attached to (يخرجون) ...
(ربّكم) a naʿt (adjective) of the Name of Majesty. (كنتم) a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). (جهادا) a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl» [Translator's note: The stray closing quotation mark here is in the source, apparently the remnant of a footnote marker.] (في سبيلي) attached to (جهادا). (ابتغاء) maʿṭūf to (جهادا), accusative. (إليهم) attached to (تسرّون). (بالمودّة) like the first in the kind of attachment. (الواو) circumstantial. (أعلم) the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (أنا), and what is meant by it is description, not comparison (tafḍīl). (بما) attached to (أعلم), and the second is conjoined to it, and the returning pronouns of both are omitted. (الواو) resumptive. (من) a jussive-governing conditional noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. (منكم) attached to a ḥāl from the agent of يفعله. (الفاء) connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). (قد) a particle of realisation. (سواء) mafʿūl bihi, accusative [Note: If (ضلّ) is taken as intransitive, (سواء) is an adverb for it.].
The vocative clause «النداء ...» has no grammatical position, being initial (ibtidāʾiyya).
The clause «آمنوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «لا تتخذوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the response to the vocative.
The clause «تلقون ...» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī) [Note: Or in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl from the agent of تتّخذوا, or in the position of the accusative as a naʿt of أولياء.].
The clause «كفروا ...» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl from the absent pronoun in (إليهم).
The clause «جاءكم ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «يخرجون ...» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption [Note: Or in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl from the agent of كفروا.].
The clause «تؤمنوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle-relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) (أن).
The clause «كنتم خرجتم ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «خرجتم ...» is in the position of the accusative as the khabar of كنتم.. and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. "then do not take My enemy.. as allies".
The clause «تسرّون ...» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl from the agent of تتّخذوا, the apodosis [Note: Or it is a badal for the clause تلقون.. and the clause may be resumptive.].
The clause «أنا أعلم ...» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl from the agent of تسرّون and تلقون.
The clause «أخفيتم ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the first relative noun (ما).
The clause «أعلنتم ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative noun (ما).
The clause «من يفعله ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «يفعله ...» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) [Note: Or the khabar is the protasis and apodosis clauses together.].
The clause «ضلّ ...» is in the position of the jussive (fī maḥall jazm) as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ.
2- (لكم) attached to a ḥāl from أعداء [Note: Or attached to أعداء.]. (يبسطوا) an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), conjoined to (يكونوا) by the wāw. (إليكم) attached to (يبسطوا). (بالسوء) attached to a ḥāl from the agent of يبسطوا, and (الباء) is for accompaniment. (الواو) a conjunction. (لو) a maṣdar-forming particle..
The interpreted maṣdar (لو تكفرون..) is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi, its governing word being ودّوا....
The clause «يثقفوكم ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «يكونوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis, not joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «يبسطوا ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the apodosis.
The clause «ودّوا ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the apodosis.
The clause «تكفرون» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle-relative (لو).
3- (الواو) a conjunction, and the second is resumptive. (لا) redundant to emphasise the negation. (أولادكم) maʿṭūf to (أرحامكم), nominative (marfūʿ). (يوم) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (تنفعكم) [Note: Or attached to (يفصل); the pause follows the attachment, or the reverse.]. (ما) a maṣdar-forming particle [Note: Or it is a relative noun in the position of the genitive, the returning pronoun being omitted.]..
The interpreted maṣdar (ما تعملون..) is in the position of the genitive by the bāʾ, attached to the khabar (بصير).
The clause «لن تنفعكم أرحامكم ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «يفصل بينكم» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption.
The clause «اللَّه ... بصير» has no grammatical position, being resumptive [Note: It may be conjoined to the clause يفصل.].
The clause «تعملون» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle-relative (ما).

* Morphology:
(3) أرحامكم: plural of رحم, a noun for the receptacle of the foetus, and meaning kinship; its pattern is فعل, with fatḥa then kasra, and it is feminine.. The pattern of أرحام is أفعال.

* Rhetoric:
Turning from the imperfect to the past: in His saying, Exalted is He: وَوَدُّوا لَوْ تَكْفُرُونَ.
He expressed it with the past tense, though the meaning is future, to indicate that their wishing for your disbelief comes before everything, and that it exists even if they do not overcome you. They want to inflict on them the harms of this world and of religion together — the killing of souls and the tearing of honour — and turning them back into disbelievers is the foremost and first of the harms in their view, because they know that their religion is dearer to them than their lives; and the most important thing for an enemy is to aim at what is dearest to his adversary.

* Benefits:
- The story of Ḥāṭib..
It is narrated that a freedwoman of Abū ʿAmr ibn Ṣayfī ibn Hāshim, called Sāra, came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ in Medina while he was preparing for the Conquest. He said to her: "Have you come as a Muslim?" She said: "No." He said:
"Have you come as an emigrant?" She said: "No." He said: "Then what has brought you?" She said: "I was in severe need."
So he urged Banū ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib to help her, and they clothed her, gave her a mount and provided for her. Then Ḥāṭib ibn Abī Baltaʿa came to her, gave her ten dīnārs, clothed her in a cloak, and had her carry a letter to the people of Mecca in which was: (From Ḥāṭib ibn Abī Baltaʿa to the people of Mecca: know that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ intends to come against you, so take your precautions.) Sāra set out, and Jibrīl came down with the news. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ sent ʿAlī, ʿAmmār, ʿUmar, Ṭalḥa, al-Zubayr, al-Miqdād and Abū Marthad — they were horsemen — and said: "Go until you reach (Rawḍat Khākh), for there is a woman in a howdah there who has a letter from Ḥāṭib to the people of Mecca. Take it from her and let her go; if she refuses, strike her neck." They caught up with her, and she denied it and swore, and they were about to return. ʿAlī said: "By Allah, we have not been lied to, nor has the Messenger of Allah ﷺ lied," and he drew his sword and said to her: "Bring out the letter or lay down your head." So she brought it out from the braids of her hair. The Messenger of Allah ﷺ summoned Ḥāṭib and said: "What made you do this?"
He said: "O Messenger of Allah, I have not disbelieved since I became Muslim, nor have I deceived you since I gave you my sincere counsel, nor have I loved them since I left them. But I was a man attached to Quraysh, not one of them by descent, and all the Emigrants with you have relatives in Mecca who protect their families and property. I feared for my family, so I wanted to do them a favour, and I knew that Allah would bring His punishment down upon them and that my letter would avail them nothing." So he believed him and accepted his excuse. ʿUmar, may Allah be pleased with him, said: "Let me, O Messenger of Allah, strike the neck of this hypocrite." The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "And what makes you know, O ʿUmar? Perhaps Allah has looked upon the people of Badr and said to them: Do what you wish, I have forgiven you." Then ʿUmar's eyes, may Allah be pleased with him, overflowed with tears, and His saying, Exalted is He, was revealed: يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لا تَتَّخِذُوا عَدُوِّي وَعَدُوَّكُمْ أَوْلِياءَ

safi-cedvel:4-6.t:
* I'rab:
(لكم) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of كانت. (في إبراهيم) attached to (أسوة) [Note: Or to a naʿt (adjective) of أسوة.. or it is the khabar of كانت and (لكم) is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from أسوة.]. (معه) an adverb, accusative (manṣūb), attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of الذين. (إذ) an adverb for the past in the position of the accusative, attached to the khabar of كان [Note: Or a badal ishtimāl (substitute of inclusion) for إبراهيم, in the position of the genitive.]. (لقومهم) attached to (قالوا). (منكم) attached to (برآء), and likewise (ممّا), so it is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the first preposition phrase. (من دون) a ḥāl from the omitted object of the verb of worship. (بكم) attached to (كفرنا). (بيننا) an adverb, accusative, attached to a ḥāl from العداوة and البغضاء, and likewise (بينكم), so it is conjoined to it. (أبدا) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to a ḥāl from العداوة and البغضاء. (حتّى) a particle of limit and of the genitive. (تؤمنوا) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied (muḍmara) أن after حتّى. (باللَّه) attached to (تؤمنوا). (وحده) a ḥāl from the Name of Majesty [Note: It is a maṣdar interpreted as a derived word, i.e. "alone".], accusative. (إلّا) for exception. (قول) excepted, accusative, from أسوة [Note: Or excepted from إبراهيم with the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. "in the sayings of Ibrāhīm, except the saying ..".]. (لأبيه) attached to (قول). (اللام) the lām of the oath, for an implied oath. (لك) attached to (أستغفرنّ). (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya). (ما) negative. The second (لك) is attached to (أملك). (من اللَّه) attached to (أملك), with the omission of a muḍāf, i.e. "from His punishment". (شيء) genitive in form, accusative in position, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (ربّنا) the one addressed (munādā), annexed (muḍāf), accusative. (عليك) attached to (توكّلنا). The first (إليك) is attached to (أنبنا); the second (إليك) is an advanced khabar of the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject) (المصير).
The clause «كانت لكم أسوة ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «قالوا ...» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «إنّا برآء ...» is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
The clause «تعبدون ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «كفرنا بكم» has no grammatical position, being a resumption within the scope of the saying.
The clause «بدا ... العداوة» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause كفرنا.
The clause «تؤمنوا» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the implied particle-relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) (أن).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تؤمنوا) is in the position of the genitive by (حتّى), attached to (بدا).
The clause «أستغفرنّ ...» has no grammatical position, being the response to the implied oath ... and the implied oath clause is in the position of the accusative as the object of saying of the maṣdar قول إبراهيم.
The clause «ما أملك ...» is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl from the agent of أستغفرنّ [Note: Or conjoined to the clause of the response to the oath.].
The clause «النداء وجوابه ...» (the vocative and its response) has no grammatical position, being a resumption within the scope of Ibrāhīm's saying [Note: The clause may be the object of saying of an implied saying that is a command from Allah, i.e. "Say: Our Lord, upon You we have relied"..].
The clause «عليك توكّلنا» has no grammatical position, being the response to the vocative.
The clause «أنبنا ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause توكّلنا.
The clause «إليك المصير» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause توكّلنا.
5- (ربّنا) like the first. (لا) prohibitive, jussive-governing. (فتنة) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative. (للذين) attached to a naʿt of (فتنة). (لنا) attached to (اغفر). (أنت) a detached pronoun borrowed for the accusative position, to emphasise the attached pronoun that is the noun of إنّ [Note: It may be a separating pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) conveying emphasis, with no governing effect.].
The clause «النداء الثانية» (the second vocative) has no grammatical position, being a resumption within the scope of the saying.
The clause «لا تجعلنا ...» has no grammatical position, being the response to the second vocative.
The clause «كفروا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «اغفر لنا ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause لا تجعلنا.
The clause «النداء الثالثة» (the third vocative) has no grammatical position, being parenthetical, of supplication.
The clause «انّك أنت العزيز» has no grammatical position, being an explanation of the cause (taʿlīl) of the request for forgiveness.
6- (اللام) the lām of the oath, for an implied oath. (قد) a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). (كان لكم فيهم أسوة..) its i'rab has preceded. (لمن) a badal (substitute) for (لكم), with repetition of the preposition. «(من) the second» a conditional noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. (الفاء) connecting the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). (هو) a separating pronoun [Note: Or a detached pronoun as mubtadaʾ whose khabar is الغنيّ, and the clause is the khabar of إنّ.]..
The clause «كان لكم ...» has no grammatical position, being the response to the implied oath.
The clause «كان يرجو ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (من).
The clause «يرجو اللَّه ...» is in the position of the accusative as the khabar of the (second) كان.
The clause «من يتولّ ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause of the response to the oath [Note: Or resumptive.].
The clause «يتولّ ...» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) [Note: Or the khabar is the protasis and apodosis clauses together.].
The clause «إنّ اللَّه هو الغنيّ ...» has no grammatical position, being a causal explanation for the omitted apodosis, i.e. "Whoever turns away, the ill consequence of his turning away is upon himself, because Allah is the Free of need."

safi-cedvel:7-7.t:
* I'rab:
(أن) a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle. (بينكم) an adverb, accusative (manṣūb), attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (بين) attached like the first adverb, so it is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to it. (منهم) attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the relative noun الذين. (الواو) resumptive, and the second is a conjunction.
The clause «عسى اللَّه ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «يجعل ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) (أن).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يجعل..) is in the position of the accusative as the khabar (predicate) of عسى..
The clause «عاديتم ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «اللَّه قدير ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive and explanatory of cause (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «اللَّه غفور ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the last resumptive clause.

safi-cedvel:8-9.t:
* I'rab:
(لا) negative. (عن الذين) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (ينهاكم). (في الدين) attached to (يقاتلوكم), the preposition being for causation. (من دياركم) attached to (يخرجوكم). (أن) a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle. (تقسطوا) an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), conjoined to تبرّوهم. (إليهم) attached to (تقسطوا)..
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تبرّوهم..) is in the position of the genitive as a badal (substitute) for the relative noun الذين, i.e. "Allah does not forbid you from dutifulness to those who ...".
The clause «لا ينهاكم اللَّه ...» has no grammatical position, being resumptive.
The clause «لم يقاتلوكم ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين).
The clause «لم يخرجوكم ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «تبرّوهم ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle-relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) (أن).
The clause «تقسطوا ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the clause تبرّوهم.
The clause «إنّ اللَّه يحبّ ...» has no grammatical position, being explanatory of cause (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «يحبّ ...» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of إنّ.
9- (إنّما) a restraining particle and the restrained particle (kāffa wa-makfūfa). (ينهاكم اللَّه عن ... من دياركم) like the first. (على إخراجكم) attached to (ظاهروا). (أن تولّوهم) like أن تبرّوهم. (الواو) resumptive. (من) a conditional noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). (الفاء) connecting the response. (هم) for separation (faṣl) [Note: Or a detached pronoun as mubtadaʾ whose khabar is الظالمون, and the clause made of the mubtadaʾ and khabar is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of أولئك.].
The clause «ينهاكم اللَّه ...» has no grammatical position, being an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
The clause «قاتلوكم ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative noun (الذين).
The clause «أخرجوكم ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «ظاهروا ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the ṣila clause.
The clause «تولّوهم ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle-relative (أن).
The clause «من يتولّهم ...» has no grammatical position, being a resumption having the force of a causal explanation.
The clause «يتولّهم ...» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من).
The clause «أولئك ... الظالمون» is in the position of the jussive (fī maḥall jazm) as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), joined with the fāʾ.

* Morphology:
(9) تولّوهم: contains the deletion of one of the two tāʾs for lightness; its origin is تتولّوهم.. It also contains iʿlāl (weak-letter change) by deletion: the alif, the lām (third radical) of the word, was deleted because it met, vowelless, with the wāw of the plural; its pattern is تفعّوهم.

safi-cedvel:10-11.t:
* I'rab:
(يأيّها الذين آمنوا) its i'rab has preceded, word by word and clause by clause [Note: In verse (1) of this sūra.]. (الفاء) connecting the response. (بإيمانهنّ) attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أعلم). (الفاء) a conjunction, and the second is connecting the response. (علمتموهن) a past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ).. and (الواو) is redundant (zāʾida), lengthening the vowel of the mīm (ishbāʿ). (مؤمنات) second mafʿūl bihi (direct object). (لا) prohibitive, jussive-governing. (إلى الكفار) attached to (ترجعوهنّ). (لا) negative, inoperative (muhmala), in the two places. (الواو) a conjunction in the six places. (لهم) attached to (حلّ). (لهنّ) attached to (يحلّون). (ما) a relative noun in the position of the accusative as second mafʿūl bihi. (لا) the lā of generic negation. (عليكم) attached to the khabar (predicate) of لا. (أن) a maṣdar-forming and accusative-governing particle.. and (الواو) in (آتيتموهنّ) is redundant, for lengthening (ishbāʿ).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن تنكحوهنّ) is in the position of the genitive by an omitted preposition, attached to the notion of settledness (al-istiqrār) which is the khabar, i.e.: "in your marrying them".
(أجورهنّ) second mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb). (لا) prohibitive, jussive-governing. (بعصم) attached to (تمسكوا). (ما) a relative noun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi of the verb of asking in the two places. The reference in (ذلكم) is to the ruling mentioned in the verses. (بينكم) an adverb, accusative, attached to (يحكم). (الواو) resumptive.
The clause «جاءكم المؤمنات ...» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
The clause «امتحنوهنّ ...» has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
The clause «اللَّه أعلم ...» has no grammatical position, being explanatory of cause (taʿlīliyya).
The clause «علمتموهنّ ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the response to the vocative:
the condition, its verb and its apodosis.
The clause «لا ترجعوهنّ» is in the position of the jussive (fī maḥall jazm) as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), joined with the fāʾ.
The clause «لا هنّ حلّ ...» has no grammatical position, being explanatory of cause.
The clause «لا هم يحلّون ...» has no grammatical position, being conjoined to the causal clause.
The clause «يحلّون ...» is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (subject) (هم).
The clause «آتوهم ...» is in the position of the jussive, conjoined to the clause لا ترجعوهنّ.
The clause «أنفقوا ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما).
The clause «لا جناح عليكم ...» is in the position of the jussive, conjoined to the clause لا ترجعوهنّ.
The clause «تنكحوهنّ» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the particle-relative (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī) (أن).
The clause «آتيتموهنّ ...» is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.. and the apodosis is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.
The clause «لا تمسكوا ...» is in the position of the jussive, conjoined to the clause لا ترجعوهنّ.
The clause «اسألوا ...» is in the position of the jussive, conjoined to the clause لا ترجعوهنّ.
The clause «أنفقتم ...» has no grammatical position, being the ṣila of the second relative noun (ما).
